content.text: The data clearly differentiates this: In Zone_F2_Z01, both the cooling and heating setpoints dropped by about 1°C (setpoint delta -0.94/-1.11°C, sensor -0.8°C), while the setpoints of the other core zones (F2Z03, F2Z07, F2Z08) stayed constant (24.6→24.65, 27→27) and their sensors did not change either. Since the change is localized to the setpoints of a single zone, this is consistent with a local override / controller offset, not a building-wide schedule change (in which case all zones should have shifted).
